entries.name: field
entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: existing game battle backdrop, input is the edit target, not inspiration. Enhance and restore detail in this exact supplied grassy field battle background. Output target 512 x 288 pixels, aspect 16:9. Keep the exact existing composition, empty battle space, horizon height at the same position, green foreground diagonal grass streaks, yellow-green far distance and pale blue-white sky band. Add restrained, crisp hand-painted fine grass texture within existing color regions; improve the smooth gradients and clean the blocky edges. Preserve the existing abstract JRPG backdrop design and original palette. The background is intentionally abstract; do not invent trees, bushes, flowers, paths, buildings, characters, creatures, battle platforms, UI, text, borders or watermarks. Do not change perspective, crop, pan, zoom, layout, object placement, lighting or overall colors. Fine detail only. Full-bleed opaque image, no transparency.
